channel.title: This Week in the Wiki
channel.description: A private weekly brief from Emin Köksal's Economics of AI wiki: what entered the wiki this week, which numbers changed, which contradictions moved, and the one source worth reading in full. Written by the wiki's maintaining model, read by a synthetic voice.
channel.itunes:subtitle: The Economics of AI wiki, read aloud once a week
channel.itunes:author: Emin Köksal

item.title: This Week in the Wiki, 5 November 2026
item.description: This is the first weekly brief from the Economics of AI wiki. It covers two batches of ingests, on the twenty-ninth of October and the fifth of November: thirty-four new source pages, six new entity pages, two new concept pages, and about forty pages updated. It runs a little over ten minutes. At the end, one source to read in full.
